findings.evidence: `FiniteType/Star/{Basic,Classification}.lean` and the parallel `FiniteType/DoubleEdge/{Basic,Classification}.lean` are the existing topic directories; `Star/Classification.lean:18-19` states it "identifies each surviving model star with its standard Cartan matrix and proves the converse, completing the classification of the model stars themselves"; `Branch.lean:119,131,138,145` call `starIndexEquivD`/`starIndexEquivE` and `Branch.lean:121,133,140,147` call `starCartanMatrix_one_*_eq_*`, all declared in that file.
findings.fix: Move the contents into `TauCeti/LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/FiniteType/Star/Classification.lean` (275 + ~140 lines, well inside the length limit), next to the `starIndexEquivD`/`starIndexEquivE` relabellings it wraps, which lets those and the entry theorems stay `private`. If a separate file is preferred, place it as `FiniteType/Star/Dynkin.lean`; either way do not use `Branch.lean`, which `Star/Basic.lean:29` reserves for the still-unproved step producing a star from a diagram with a branch vertex.
findings.issue: Every declaration here is about stars (`IsStarOfType` is defined on `StarIndex ℓ`/`starCartanMatrix ℓ`; `isStarOfType_D/E6/E7/E8` are wrappers over `starIndexEquivD`, `starIndexEquivE` and `starCartanMatrix_one_*_eq_*`), yet the file sits at `FiniteType/` level rather than in the existing `FiniteType/Star/` topic subdirectory. The split is also what forces `starIndexEquivD`, `starIndexEquivE` and the three `starCartanMatrix_*_eq_*` theorems out of `private` in this PR.

findings.evidence: The only occurrence is `Branch.lean:170` (`⟨Tuple.sort ℓ, Tuple.monotone_sort ℓ⟩`), inside the proof of `existsUnique_dynkinType_of_star`. Repo precedent for proof-only Mathlib deps: `TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/Cylinder.lean:9` uses plain `import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Sort`, and `FiniteType/Dynkin.lean:8` uses plain `import Mathlib.Data.Rat.Star`.
findings.issue: `public import Mathlib.Data.Fin.Tuple.Sort` exports a dependency used only inside a tactic proof; no statement in the file mentions `Tuple`.

summary: The new file is entirely star material built on `FiniteType/Star/Classification.lean`, but lands at `FiniteType/Branch.lean` instead of in the existing `FiniteType/Star/` topic directory; one Mathlib import is marked `public` although it is used only inside a proof.
